tools.description: What is on the agent workspace: windows, processes, whether it is showing.
tools.name: agent_status

tools.description: Windows on the agent workspace you may act on.
tools.name: agent_windows

tools.description: Start an allowlisted app on the agent workspace, by name, as its own process with its own session bus. You stay where you are. Only files inside the handoff folder may be passed: no flags, no paths to programs, no URLs (bad_arguments). An app not on the allowlist is needs_sandbox before it starts.

app.description: The app's name, such as foot. Never a path.

args.description: Paths of files inside the handoff folder.

tools.name: agent_open

tools.description: Accessibility tree of one agent window, with refs to act on.

window.description: A window id from agent_windows or agent_open (the Hyprland address, 0x...).

tools.description: Find elements in an agent window by role, name or text.

window.description: A window id from agent_windows or agent_open (the Hyprland address, 0x...).

tools.description: Read this first: the JSON Schema of config.toml, every setting with its type, range and default.
tools.name: config_schema

tools.description: The effective value of a setting (defaults filled in), or the whole config when no path is given.

path.description: A setting by dotted path, such as animation.dock.in.duration_ms or keys.bindings."mod+1".

tools.name: config_get

tools.description: Change one setting. Validated first and applied live; refused changes name the exact path and reason (config_invalid) and change nothing. value is any JSON.

path.description: A setting by dotted path, such as animation.dock.in.duration_ms or keys.bindings."mod+1".

value.description: The new value, as JSON: a string, number, boolean, array or table.

tools.name: config_set

tools.description: Put one setting back to its default.

path.description: A setting by dotted path, such as animation.dock.in.duration_ms or keys.bindings."mod+1".

tools.name: config_unset

tools.description: Replace the whole config with a TOML or JSON document, validated as one change.

text.description: A whole config document as TOML or JSON text.

tools.name: config_apply

tools.description: Check a document without applying it.

text.description: A whole config document as TOML or JSON text.

tools.name: config_validate

tools.description: What differs from the defaults, or from a history version.
tools.name: config_diff

tools.description: Step back n versions (default 1). The last 50 are kept.
tools.name: config_undo

tools.description: The versions kept, newest first, each with time, caller and a one-line summary.
tools.name: config_history

tools.description: Put a section (keys, theme, animation, behavior, rules, hooks) or everything back to the defaults. Always works.
tools.name: config_reset

tools.description: Built-in and custom themes, and the palettes.

tools.description: A theme's resolved tokens and palette.

name.description: A theme name: built-in (baneyspaces, omarchy, minimal) or a custom one.

tools.name: theme_show

tools.description: Create a custom theme (themes/<name>.toml) that extends another, with optional tokens to change and an optional palette of the twelve roles.

extends.description: A theme name: built-in (baneyspaces, omarchy, minimal) or a custom one.

palette.description: The twelve palette roles as #rrggbb, and optionally mode.

tokens.description: Tokens to change, as in spec/themes.json.

tools.name: theme_create

name.description: A theme name: built-in (baneyspaces, omarchy, minimal) or a custom one.

tools.name: theme_set

name.description: A theme name: built-in (baneyspaces, omarchy, minimal) or a custom one.
